pb-youtube.title: Edit video by words
pb-youtube.honesty: This saves an edit list. Your footage stays in your editor until you export it.
pb-youtube.empty: Import the word-time file from your transcription tool to start.
pb-youtube.large: This removes {percent}% of the footage. Read the preview, then confirm.
pb-youtube.measuredOnly: Cuts use measured quiet across all audio channels. No measurements means no guessed cut.
pb-youtube.filler: Review this meaningful filler; it was kept:
pb-youtube.names: Your names list, one per line
pb-youtube.fixes: Corrections as JSON: index, before, after
pb-youtube.error.EDIT_STALE: This edit changed. Open it again before applying the request.
pb-youtube.error.EDIT_AI_UNAVAILABLE: Connect your AI and agree to Chats first, or use Suggest without AI.
pb-youtube.error.EDIT_ASK_AGAIN: This removes more than a fifth of the footage. Confirm the exact preview.
pb-youtube.error.EDIT_TOO_MANY: Use at most forty operations in one request.
pb-youtube.error.EDIT_INVALID: Check the word ids, operation fields and measured times.
pb-youtube.error.EDIT_NOT_FOUND: This edit is not in the open business.
pb-youtube.error.WORD_TIMES_REQUIRED: Import measured word-time JSON. SRT cue timings are not word timings.
pb-youtube.error.RIGHTS_REQUIRED: Record current rights to the footage on the order first.
pb-youtube.error.DERIVED_STALE: The transcript changed. Make this output again.
pb-youtube.error.CHAT_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Read and agree to the AI data notice in Chats first.
pb-youtube.error.CHAT_CONSENT_STALE: Your AI connection changed. Read and agree to its notice again.
pb-youtube.error.MODEL_OUTPUT_INVALID: Your AI did not return valid typed edits. Nothing changed.
pb-youtube.error.CONTENT_HELD: The transcript contains instructions aimed at the AI. Review the held content first.
pb-youtube.error.MODEL_HASH_MISMATCH: The model differs from its pinned hash. Choose the verified model file.
pb-youtube.error.EDIT_NOTHING_TO_UNDO: There is no edit request to undo.
pb-youtube.error.EDIT_NOT_PENDING: No large edit is waiting for confirmation.
pb-youtube.error.APP_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: Approve this inside the Chausar app.
pb-youtube.error.TIER_UNAVAILABLE: Use the desktop app for local models, or import a transcript here.
pb-youtube.error.UPLOAD_LIMIT: Choose a word-time JSON file smaller than one megabyte.
pb-youtube.error.ORDER_NOT_FOUND: Choose an open order in this business.
pb-youtube.error.INVALID_VENTURE_REQUEST: Check the named fields and try again.
pb-youtube.error.general: The edit could not be saved. Read it again and try once more.
pb-youtube.code.EDIT_WORD_UNKNOWN: That word id is not in this transcript.
pb-youtube.code.EDIT_CUT_OVERLAP: This overlaps a cut already in the edit.
pb-youtube.code.EDIT_NOT_CUT: That range was not cut, so it cannot be restored.
pb-youtube.code.EDIT_INVALID: The operation fields or values are invalid.
pb-youtube.code.DICTIONARY_BEFORE_CHANGE: The word at that index no longer matches before.
pb-youtube.code.DICTIONARY_TERM_UNKNOWN: The proposed name is not in your names list.
pb-youtube.code.DICTIONARY_NOT_SIMILAR: The spelling is less than ninety percent similar.
pb-youtube.op.title: Title
pb-youtube.modelsHelp: Each tier uses a pinned local model. You download it yourself, then set its path in Connections. Chausar checks the exact file before running it.
pb-youtube.error.TRANSCRIPT_MEASUREMENTS: Import measured voice-activity regions before running a tier.
pb-youtube.error.TRANSCRIBE_NOT_AVAILABL: Set up whisper.cpp and the verified model in Connections, and set the footage path on the order.
pb-youtube.caption.notRun.safe-area: Not checked: caption positions were not measured.
pb-youtube.caption.notRun.face-overlap: Not checked: face positions were not supplied.
pb-youtube.caption.notRun.pause-breaks: Not checked: the cues have no word times.
pb-youtube.sourceHelp: Add the source transcript, recording or media asset to this order first.
pb-youtube.error.WORD_SOURCE_REQUIRED: Choose the current source file from this order.
